meta.title: Reinforcements
meta.description: Duty calls and lives are at stake. Enemies of old are now new allies.

units.rawText: Several minutes before Odile revealed herself, at Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Several minutes before Odile revealed herself, at Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Several minutes before Odile revealed herself, at Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: Antonina falls back to the rear of the group in order to take a call while I am speaking to the Lesser Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Antonina falls back to the rear of the group in order to take a call while I am speaking to the Lesser Sanctifier.

spans.text: Antonina falls back to the rear of the group in order to take a call while I am speaking to the Lesser Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Hello, this is Antonina.
units.displayText: Hello, this is Antonina.

spans.text: Hello, this is Antonina.

units.rawText: We are the former garrison forces of Sanctifier Watchtower 05. We received a distress call on this frequency 13 minutes ago.
units.displayText: We are the former garrison forces of Sanctifier Watchtower 05. We received a distress call on this frequency 13 minutes ago.

spans.text: We are the former garrison forces of Sanctifier Watchtower 05. We received a distress call on this frequency 13 minutes ago.

units.rawText: Did you send the message? Please explain your situation.
units.displayText: Did you send the message? Please explain your situation.

spans.text: Did you send the message? Please explain your situation.

units.rawText: ...What did you say just now? The "former garrison forces of Sanctifier Watchtower 05?"
units.displayText: ...What did you say just now? The "former garrison forces of Sanctifier Watchtower 05?"

spans.text: ...What did you say just now? The "former garrison forces of Sanctifier Watchtower 05?"

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05 was overrun by Entropic virus units several hours ago. I retreated with my subordinates and requested reinforcements from the Reverse Tower. We are currently on our way back.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05 was overrun by Entropic virus units several hours ago. I retreated with my subordinates and requested reinforcements from the Reverse Tower. We are currently on our way back.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05 was overrun by Entropic virus units several hours ago. I retreated with my subordinates and requested reinforcements from the Reverse Tower. We are currently on our way back.

units.rawText: After sending the comms request, we soon receive a reply.
units.displayText: After sending the comms request, we soon receive a reply.

spans.text: After sending the comms request, we soon receive a reply.

units.rawText: [Unknown communications request detected. Please respond.]
units.displayText: [Unknown communications request detected. Please respond.]

spans.text: [Unknown communications request detected. Please respond.]

units.rawText: So quickly? I thought we'd have to wait several minutes to get through...
units.displayText: So quickly? I thought we'd have to wait several minutes to get through...

spans.text: So quickly? I thought we'd have to wait several minutes to get through...

units.rawText: Are they the real deal? Then the ones who led us here...
units.displayText: Are they the real deal? Then the ones who led us here...

spans.text: Are they the real deal? Then the ones who led us here...

units.rawText: Hello? Agent in distress, please describe the situation.
units.displayText: Hello? Agent in distress, please describe the situation.

spans.text: Hello? Agent in distress, please describe the situation.

units.rawText: Oh no—I was careless!
units.displayText: Oh no—I was careless!

spans.text: Oh no—I was careless!

units.rawText: Antonina whirls around—and at the same time, she sees black wings diving down.
units.displayText: Antonina whirls around—and at the same time, she sees black wings diving down.

spans.text: Antonina whirls around—and at the same time, she sees black wings diving down.

units.rawText: Her body moves before her thoughts can catch up.
units.displayText: Her body moves before her thoughts can catch up.

spans.text: Her body moves before her thoughts can catch up.

units.rawText: (Stab)
units.displayText: (Stab)

spans.text: (Stab)

units.rawText: (Coughs)
units.displayText: Coughs

spans.text: Coughs

units.rawText: Antonina!
units.displayText: Antonina!

spans.text: Antonina!

units.rawText: It's an ambush... Professor...
units.displayText: It's an ambush... Professor...

spans.text: It's an ambush... Professor...

units.rawText: Welcome to the stage I have prepared for you.
units.displayText: Welcome to the stage I have prepared for you.

spans.text: Welcome to the stage I have prepared for you.

units.rawText: Did you enjoy this welcome?
units.displayText: Did you enjoy this welcome?

spans.text: Did you enjoy this welcome?

units.rawText: Odile... You!
units.displayText: Odile... You!

spans.text: Odile... You!

units.rawText: My, my. The hero expected to be the subject of a sneak attack, but it was the magician to the side who suffered from it instead.
units.displayText: My, my. The hero expected to be the subject of a sneak attack, but it was the magician to the side who suffered from it instead.

spans.text: My, my. The hero expected to be the subject of a sneak attack, but it was the magician to the side who suffered from it instead.

units.rawText: What an unexpected turn of events, is it not... Don't you find it surprising?
units.displayText: What an unexpected turn of events, is it not... Don't you find it surprising?

spans.text: What an unexpected turn of events, is it not... Don't you find it surprising?

units.rawText: I do not answer. Instead, I fire off an operand attack. There shouldn't be a way for her to dodge at such close range, but instead Odile loosens her claws' hold.
units.displayText: I do not answer. Instead, I fire off an operand attack. There shouldn't be a way for her to dodge at such close range, but instead Odile loosens her claws' hold.

spans.text: I do not answer. Instead, I fire off an operand attack. There shouldn't be a way for her to dodge at such close range, but instead Odile loosens her claws' hold.

units.rawText: Ngh... Target locked...!
units.displayText: Ngh... Target locked...!

spans.text: Ngh... Target locked...!

units.rawText: Odile swipes away Antonina's grip on her and she uses the momentum to gently land near me.
units.displayText: Odile swipes away Antonina's grip on her and she uses the momentum to gently land near me.

spans.text: Odile swipes away Antonina's grip on her and she uses the momentum to gently land near me.

units.rawText: I immediately go to catch Antonina and issue an order to the agents behind me.
units.displayText: I immediately go to catch Antonina and issue an order to the agents behind me.

spans.text: I immediately go to catch Antonina and issue an order to the agents behind me.

units.rawText: Fire!
units.displayText: Fire!

spans.text: Fire!

units.rawText: Roger!
units.displayText: Roger!

spans.text: Roger!

units.rawText: The agent fighters attack Odile and I withdraw outside the building with a now-unconscious Antonina.
units.displayText: The agent fighters attack Odile and I withdraw outside the building with a now-unconscious Antonina.

spans.text: The agent fighters attack Odile and I withdraw outside the building with a now-unconscious Antonina.

units.rawText: A good decision, but... everything you have done since choosing to enter the Watchtower is nothing more than a branch off of a bad choice.
units.displayText: A good decision, but... everything you have done since choosing to enter the Watchtower is nothing more than a branch off of a bad choice.

spans.text: A good decision, but... everything you have done since choosing to enter the Watchtower is nothing more than a branch off of a bad choice.

units.rawText: Odile flaps her wings as she soars through the air. Entropics emerge from behind the structure and close in on us.
units.displayText: Odile flaps her wings as she soars through the air. Entropics emerge from behind the structure and close in on us.

spans.text: Odile flaps her wings as she soars through the air. Entropics emerge from behind the structure and close in on us.

units.rawText: Professor, we're running low on ammo!
units.displayText: Professor, we're running low on ammo!

spans.text: Professor, we're running low on ammo!

units.rawText: Save two mags! We're repositioning to another part of the Watchtower!
units.displayText: Save two mags! We're repositioning to another part of the Watchtower!

spans.text: Save two mags! We're repositioning to another part of the Watchtower!

units.rawText: I take Antonina's terminal from her and check the map she was consulting just now. After matching the Entropics' movements to the positions on the map, computing where they'll be next isn't difficult.
units.displayText: I take Antonina's terminal from her and check the map she was consulting just now. After matching the Entropics' movements to the positions on the map, computing where they'll be next isn't difficult.

spans.text: I take Antonina's terminal from her and check the map she was consulting just now. After matching the Entropics' movements to the positions on the map, computing where they'll be next isn't difficult.

units.rawText: There should be about five Entropic packs near Gate No. 1, three at the foot of the Watchtower, five more in the barracks...
units.displayText: There should be about five Entropic packs near Gate No. 1, three at the foot of the Watchtower, five more in the barracks...

spans.text: There should be about five Entropic packs near Gate No. 1, three at the foot of the Watchtower, five more in the barracks...

units.rawText: The Area C entrance is blocked by six Entropic packs, while the Area B entrance... only has one pack, and the armory's in Area B.
units.displayText: The Area C entrance is blocked by six Entropic packs, while the Area B entrance... only has one pack, and the armory's in Area B.

spans.text: The Area C entrance is blocked by six Entropic packs, while the Area B entrance... only has one pack, and the armory's in Area B.

units.rawText: Everyone, head toward Area B!
units.displayText: Everyone, head toward Area B!

spans.text: Everyone, head toward Area B!

units.rawText: Rearm if you find any supplies, then immediately circle around to Area A. Don't stay in the same place for too long! Buy as much time as possible!
units.displayText: Rearm if you find any supplies, then immediately circle around to Area A. Don't stay in the same place for too long! Buy as much time as possible!

spans.text: Rearm if you find any supplies, then immediately circle around to Area A. Don't stay in the same place for too long! Buy as much time as possible!

units.rawText: We barely manage to escape to Area B, where we quickly grab some ammo before leaving and playing a game of hide and seek inside the white-colored building.
units.displayText: We barely manage to escape to Area B, where we quickly grab some ammo before leaving and playing a game of hide and seek inside the white-colored building.

spans.text: We barely manage to escape to Area B, where we quickly grab some ammo before leaving and playing a game of hide and seek inside the white-colored building.

units.rawText: Professor, our casualties have exceeded 40%.
units.displayText: Professor, our casualties have exceeded 40%.

spans.text: Professor, our casualties have exceeded 40%.

units.rawText: Please prepare an appropriate contingency plan, Professor. We might not be able to stay with you much longer.
units.displayText: Please prepare an appropriate contingency plan, Professor. We might not be able to stay with you much longer.

spans.text: Please prepare an appropriate contingency plan, Professor. We might not be able to stay with you much longer.

units.rawText: I look around. There aren't many agent fighters still following me.
units.displayText: I look around. There aren't many agent fighters still following me.

spans.text: I look around. There aren't many agent fighters still following me.

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry. We'll definitely make it through this battle.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry. We'll definitely make it through this battle.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry. We'll definitely make it through this battle.

units.rawText: Sacrifice is part of this fight. We'll obey any orders you give till the very end.
units.displayText: Sacrifice is part of this fight. We'll obey any orders you give till the very end.

spans.text: Sacrifice is part of this fight. We'll obey any orders you give till the very end.

units.rawText: Please don't blame yourself. There'll be a new me to accompany you afterwards.
units.displayText: Please don't blame yourself. There'll be a new me to accompany you afterwards.

spans.text: Please don't blame yourself. There'll be a new me to accompany you afterwards.

units.rawText: ...Thank you.
units.displayText: ...Thank you.

spans.text: ...Thank you.

units.rawText: Just as I finish, a dark shadow appears in the air as planned. Two agents immediately open fire but she knocks them down with a dive.
units.displayText: Just as I finish, a dark shadow appears in the air as planned. Two agents immediately open fire but she knocks them down with a dive.

spans.text: Just as I finish, a dark shadow appears in the air as planned. Two agents immediately open fire but she knocks them down with a dive.

units.rawText: Oh my, Professor. Are you sad?
units.displayText: Oh my, Professor. Are you sad?

spans.text: Oh my, Professor. Are you sad?

units.rawText: You're grieving over a mook's exit? Even if the audience won't remember them?
units.displayText: You're grieving over a mook's exit? Even if the audience won't remember them?

spans.text: You're grieving over a mook's exit? Even if the audience won't remember them?

units.rawText: Of course, of course, this is part of building the hero's character... To write the saga of your growth in blood and sacrifice.
units.displayText: Of course, of course, this is part of building the hero's character... To write the saga of your growth in blood and sacrifice.

spans.text: Of course, of course, this is part of building the hero's character... To write the saga of your growth in blood and sacrifice.

units.rawText: How pointless and beautiful it is! And I, I shall bear witness to this saga.
units.displayText: How pointless and beautiful it is! And I, I shall bear witness to this saga.

spans.text: How pointless and beautiful it is! And I, I shall bear witness to this saga.

units.rawText: In order to sing it to my master, I shall play the cruel executioner who will lower the curtain on you.
units.displayText: In order to sing it to my master, I shall play the cruel executioner who will lower the curtain on you.

spans.text: In order to sing it to my master, I shall play the cruel executioner who will lower the curtain on you.

options.rawText: Can you talk in anything besides riddles?
options.displayText: Can you talk in anything besides riddles?

spans.text: Can you talk in anything besides riddles?

options.rawText: What exactly are you up to?
options.displayText: What exactly are you up to?

spans.text: What exactly are you up to?

units.rawText: Art is always misunderstood... But it does not bother me.
units.displayText: Art is always misunderstood... But it does not bother me.

spans.text: Art is always misunderstood... But it does not bother me.

units.rawText: For my art belongs to my master alone.
units.displayText: For my art belongs to my master alone.

spans.text: For my art belongs to my master alone.

units.rawText: What reason would I need?
units.displayText: What reason would I need?

spans.text: What reason would I need?

units.rawText: The Master bade me to set out, and so I did.
units.displayText: The Master bade me to set out, and so I did.

spans.text: The Master bade me to set out, and so I did.

units.rawText: And now we meet again, by the design of my master... Is it not a fated encounter?
units.displayText: And now we meet again, by the design of my master... Is it not a fated encounter?

spans.text: And now we meet again, by the design of my master... Is it not a fated encounter?

options.rawText: I have no quarrel with you.
options.displayText: I have no quarrel with you.

spans.text: I have no quarrel with you.

options.rawText: I was waiting to settle the score with you.
options.displayText: I was waiting to settle the score with you.

spans.text: I was waiting to settle the score with you.

units.rawText: Hahaha, can you truly say there is anybody in Magrasea with no quarrel against us?
units.displayText: Hahaha, can you truly say there is anybody in Magrasea with no quarrel against us?

spans.text: Hahaha, can you truly say there is anybody in Magrasea with no quarrel against us?

units.rawText: In that case, we have flown into each other's arms, have we not?
units.displayText: In that case, we have flown into each other's arms, have we not?

spans.text: In that case, we have flown into each other's arms, have we not?

units.rawText: You and that green-haired little moppet of yours have been studying how to deal with us, haven't you?
units.displayText: You and that green-haired little moppet of yours have been studying how to deal with us, haven't you?

spans.text: You and that green-haired little moppet of yours have been studying how to deal with us, haven't you?

units.rawText: Look at these agents... Even when we slice them open and pour Liquid Entropy onto their wounds, they do not instantly become one of us...
units.displayText: Look at these agents... Even when we slice them open and pour Liquid Entropy onto their wounds, they do not instantly become one of us...

spans.text: Look at these agents... Even when we slice them open and pour Liquid Entropy onto their wounds, they do not instantly become one of us...

units.rawText: The Master is truly delighted! Your leadership and her technology...
units.displayText: The Master is truly delighted! Your leadership and her technology...

spans.text: The Master is truly delighted! Your leadership and her technology...

units.rawText: If you were to become part of us, then these exquisite qualities would become part of our collection.
units.displayText: If you were to become part of us, then these exquisite qualities would become part of our collection.

spans.text: If you were to become part of us, then these exquisite qualities would become part of our collection.

units.rawText: Odile approaches us, and behind her, more and more Entropics boil out of the shadows.
units.displayText: Odile approaches us, and behind her, more and more Entropics boil out of the shadows.

spans.text: Odile approaches us, and behind her, more and more Entropics boil out of the shadows.

units.rawText: I advise you not to come any closer.
units.displayText: I advise you not to come any closer.

spans.text: I advise you not to come any closer.

units.rawText: Such feeble threats ill suit you, Professor. Go on, put more force into it.
units.displayText: Such feeble threats ill suit you, Professor. Go on, put more force into it.

spans.text: Such feeble threats ill suit you, Professor. Go on, put more force into it.

units.rawText: I warn you for the last time—stay back.
units.displayText: I warn you for the last time—stay back.

spans.text: I warn you for the last time—stay back.

units.rawText: Surely running around and hiding in the Watchtower is only delaying the inevitable, is it not?
units.displayText: Surely running around and hiding in the Watchtower is only delaying the inevitable, is it not?

spans.text: Surely running around and hiding in the Watchtower is only delaying the inevitable, is it not?

units.rawText: Before she can finish, the crisp sound of gunshots erupts from behind me.
units.displayText: Before she can finish, the crisp sound of gunshots erupts from behind me.

spans.text: Before she can finish, the crisp sound of gunshots erupts from behind me.

units.rawText: [Large quantities of Entropic individuals detected!]
units.displayText: [Large quantities of Entropic individuals detected!]

spans.text: [Large quantities of Entropic individuals detected!]

units.rawText: [Initiating cleansing programs!]
units.displayText: [Initiating cleansing programs!]

spans.text: [Initiating cleansing programs!]

units.rawText: What? How did they come so quickly...
units.displayText: What? How did they come so quickly...

spans.text: What? How did they come so quickly...

units.rawText: Do you know why I was drawing things out in the Watchtower?
units.displayText: Do you know why I was drawing things out in the Watchtower?

spans.text: Do you know why I was drawing things out in the Watchtower?

units.rawText: Not to cling to life, of course... I was waiting for the cavalry to arrive.
units.displayText: Not to cling to life, of course... I was waiting for the cavalry to arrive.

spans.text: Not to cling to life, of course... I was waiting for the cavalry to arrive.

units.rawText: Odile's gaze shifts to Antonina's terminal, which is in my hands.
units.displayText: Odile's gaze shifts to Antonina's terminal, which is in my hands.

spans.text: Odile's gaze shifts to Antonina's terminal, which is in my hands.

units.rawText: We are the former garrison forces of Sanctifier Watchtower 05. We received a distress call on this frequency 13 minutes ago.
units.displayText: We are the former garrison forces of Sanctifier Watchtower 05. We received a distress call on this frequency 13 minutes ago.

spans.text: We are the former garrison forces of Sanctifier Watchtower 05. We received a distress call on this frequency 13 minutes ago.

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05 was overrun by Entropic virus units several hours ago. I retreated with my subordinates and requested reinforcements from the Reverse Tower. We are currently on our way back.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05 was overrun by Entropic virus units several hours ago. I retreated with my subordinates and requested reinforcements from the Reverse Tower. We are currently on our way back.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05 was overrun by Entropic virus units several hours ago. I retreated with my subordinates and requested reinforcements from the Reverse Tower. We are currently on our way back.

units.rawText: Hello? Agent in distress, please describe the situation.
units.displayText: Hello? Agent in distress, please describe the situation.

spans.text: Hello? Agent in distress, please describe the situation.

units.rawText: So you were in contact with the Sanctifiers all this time... No wonder you were stating your location and the positions of the Entropic forces so loudly.
units.displayText: So you were in contact with the Sanctifiers all this time... No wonder you were stating your location and the positions of the Entropic forces so loudly.

spans.text: So you were in contact with the Sanctifiers all this time... No wonder you were stating your location and the positions of the Entropic forces so loudly.

units.rawText: If you dare pretend to be a Sanctifier, then you have to be ready for the real deal to confront you.
units.displayText: If you dare pretend to be a Sanctifier, then you have to be ready for the real deal to confront you.

spans.text: If you dare pretend to be a Sanctifier, then you have to be ready for the real deal to confront you.

units.rawText: ...Looks like I'll have to be a little rough with you.
units.displayText: ...Looks like I'll have to be a little rough with you.

spans.text: ...Looks like I'll have to be a little rough with you.

units.rawText: Come with me, Professor.
units.displayText: Come with me, Professor.

spans.text: Come with me, Professor.

units.rawText: Odile flashes forward like a phantom, closing the distance to me in an instant.
units.displayText: Odile flashes forward like a phantom, closing the distance to me in an instant.

spans.text: Odile flashes forward like a phantom, closing the distance to me in an instant.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: A white-colored shield suddenly slams down from above, between me and Odile.
units.displayText: A white-colored shield suddenly slams down from above, between me and Odile.

spans.text: A white-colored shield suddenly slams down from above, between me and Odile.

units.rawText: This is the leader of the garrison of former Sanctifier Watchtower 05, Intermediate Sanctifier Faith, reporting.
units.displayText: This is the leader of the garrison of former Sanctifier Watchtower 05, Intermediate Sanctifier Faith, reporting.

spans.text: This is the leader of the garrison of former Sanctifier Watchtower 05, Intermediate Sanctifier Faith, reporting.

units.rawText: Target Signature verified... You are on Lord Eosphorus' whitelist.
units.displayText: Target Signature verified... You are on Lord Eosphorus' whitelist.

spans.text: Target Signature verified... You are on Lord Eosphorus' whitelist.

units.rawText: From now on, they will be subjects of our protection. Focus fire and eliminate the Daemons!
units.displayText: From now on, they will be subjects of our protection. Focus fire and eliminate the Daemons!

spans.text: From now on, they will be subjects of our protection. Focus fire and eliminate the Daemons!

units.rawText: [Order received, Lady Faith. Now adjusting formation.]
units.displayText: [Order received, Lady Faith. Now adjusting formation.]

spans.text: [Order received, Lady Faith. Now adjusting formation.]

units.rawText: An unexpected knight takes the stage... To think you would be brave enough to come back.
units.displayText: An unexpected knight takes the stage... To think you would be brave enough to come back.

spans.text: An unexpected knight takes the stage... To think you would be brave enough to come back.

units.rawText: Certainly, your courage is admirable, but charging in blindly will only leave your bones on the battlefield.
units.displayText: Certainly, your courage is admirable, but charging in blindly will only leave your bones on the battlefield.

spans.text: Certainly, your courage is admirable, but charging in blindly will only leave your bones on the battlefield.

units.rawText: The Entropics slither out of every nook and crevice, and Liquid Entropy flows throughout the Watchtower.
units.displayText: The Entropics slither out of every nook and crevice, and Liquid Entropy flows throughout the Watchtower.

spans.text: The Entropics slither out of every nook and crevice, and Liquid Entropy flows throughout the Watchtower.

units.rawText: Faith pulls back her intercepting shield and holds it high before herself like a banner.
units.displayText: Faith pulls back her intercepting shield and holds it high before herself like a banner.

spans.text: Faith pulls back her intercepting shield and holds it high before herself like a banner.

units.rawText: We hone our blades in the darkness. We hold up order in the face of chaos. We bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the darkness. We hold up order in the face of chaos. We bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the darkness. We hold up order in the face of chaos. We bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not be reckless because we are strong, and neither can we flee because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not be reckless because we are strong, and neither can we flee because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not be reckless because we are strong, and neither can we flee because we are weak.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: Because we obey the same voice, together in eternity.
units.displayText: Because we obey the same voice, together in eternity.

spans.text: Because we obey the same voice, together in eternity.

units.rawText: The white shield cleaves apart the monsters before it, and the knight leads her forces in a charge.
units.displayText: The white shield cleaves apart the monsters before it, and the knight leads her forces in a charge.

spans.text: The white shield cleaves apart the monsters before it, and the knight leads her forces in a charge.

units.rawText: Onward, for the glory of Magrasea!
units.displayText: Onward, for the glory of Magrasea!

spans.text: Onward, for the glory of Magrasea!

units.rawText: Still trying to hack my neural cloud under the circumstances? I must say, your willpower is truly admirable.
units.displayText: Still trying to hack my neural cloud under the circumstances? I must say, your willpower is truly admirable.

spans.text: Still trying to hack my neural cloud under the circumstances? I must say, your willpower is truly admirable.

units.rawText: But still, it is a plot point that falls within the considerations of the script.
units.displayText: But still, it is a plot point that falls within the considerations of the script.

spans.text: But still, it is a plot point that falls within the considerations of the script.
